name: project-check
description: Review engineering projects for cost reduction and TRIZ innovation, and find relevant TRIZ cases. Explore technology news, build trends boards, schedule checks, and export reports.

interface.shortDescription: Run engineering checks with cloud tools and guided workflows
interface.longDescription: Review an engineering proposal using R&D Cost Optimization, TRIZ Innovation, and the TRIZ Case Library. Use the built-in Technology Discovery app to save product profiles and assess selected news. Build a trends board with links to technology, patents, and news, or schedule recurring checks in Codex. Export findings in Markdown, HTML, or Word. Reports and the Technology Discovery app support English and Chinese.
defaultPrompt: Review the engineering proposal in this conversation.
Open Technology Discovery with fictional demo data.
Export the current findings to Word.
